get.description:
Mint a single-use console URL for the instance.

Returns a wss:// URL with a short-TTL bearer token in the query
string. Open it from xterm.js (or wscat) within `expires_at` to attach
to the QEMU serial line — bidirectional, hot-attached, no VM restart.

`type=vnc` is reserved; we currently only ship serial because the GPU
VMs are headless and graphics frame buffers waste RAM that the GPU
workload could otherwise use.

Browser-friendly serial console — a tiny xterm.js page that calls
GET /console + opens the WebSocket. No server-side auth on this route
(it's static HTML); the page itself collects a bearer token and uses
it client-side. The terminal stream is gated by the one-shot console
token minted via /console (which DOES require auth).

Get attestation report for a CC-enabled instance.

Returns Intel TDX quote, NVIDIA GPU attestation JWT, measurement
registers, and verification status. Returns 400 if the instance
was not launched in CC mode.

get.description: Get account prepaid balance.

List volumes. Soft-deleted volumes are hidden by default — pass
?include_deleted=true to include trash, or ?status=deleted to get only trash.

delete.description:
Delete a volume.

By default this is a **soft-delete**: the volume row stays in the DB with
``status='deleted'`` and ``deleted_at=now()``, and the underlying LV on the
host is left intact so it can be recovered via POST /volumes/{id}/restore
within the trash TTL (default 24 h). A background reaper purges trashed
volumes after the TTL expires.

Pass ``?purge=true`` to skip the trash and hard-delete immediately.

parameters.name: purge

schema.description: Skip trash and permanently delete immediately
schema.title: Purge

parameters.description: Skip trash and permanently delete immediately

post.description:
Restore a soft-deleted volume. Only works while the volume is still in
trash (i.e. before the reaper has purged it).

Clone a volume (same-region only for MVP).

Live mode: creates an LVM thin snapshot on the source's host. O(1)
metadata op; the two volumes diverge via CoW after the snap.

Stub mode: creates a DB row pointing at nothing.

Cross-region clone is rejected with 422 — it requires copying data
over the network and is out of MVP scope.

Create a filesystem: its own VAST view with a hard quota of size_gb GiB.

Live mode answers with status `creating` and finishes in the background
(Operation `filesystem.create`); stub mode creates it inline.

delete.description:
Delete a filesystem. Must not be mounted by any instances.

VAST-backed: removes the view and quota (live mode: status `deleting`
until the background job removes the row). Level-0 rows: DB only.

post.description: Resize a filesystem (expand only). VAST-backed: changes the hard quota.

get.description:
Reference measurements for confidential (Intel TDX) instances.

For every sealed guest image release and every instance shape recorded for
it: MRTD, RTMR0, RTMR2, the composefs root digest and the TDVF hash, when it
was recorded and which hosts match it, plus the RIM and Intel Trust
Authority policy ids. Public, cached for a minute, no token needed.
